remainingFindings.summary: bulkSetChannelPolicies uses the caller supplied organizationKey as both the stable Slack organization key and the durable organizations/workspaces organizationId.
remainingFindings.details: packages/convex/confect/slack/channelPolicies.impl.ts loads sourceChannels and policy rows by input.organizationKey, but authorizes via organizationMembers.by_organization_user and discovers Client Brain targets through workspaces.by_organization_kind using that same value as organizationId. Existing Slack connection code persists provider/source organizationKey from organizations.agencyKey, while memberships and workspaces are keyed by the durable organization _id. An admin for a real organization cannot be authorized for its agencyKey, and switching the input to _id would miss provider/source rows. This breaks the tenant boundary and makes the public policy mutation unusable or incorrectly scoped despite the pure planner tests passing.
